ios.desc:
Vantage is a longevity coach, not another dashboard. It reads your Apple Health data and tells you what to do today for your training, nutrition and sleep. Two scores. No streaks. Start with a 7-day free trial.

Most health apps show you fifteen metrics and leave you to figure out what to do. Vantage shows you two numbers — Recovery and Longevity — and the actions worth taking today. That's the whole idea. Radical simplicity, on purpose.

WHAT VANTAGE DOES

Reads your Apple Health data with your permission: sleep, activity, workouts, heart rate, HRV, body measurements and nutrition. Writes your weight and body measurements back. You choose what to share and can revoke it any time.

Gives you two scores. Recovery tells you how ready you are to train today. Longevity is one number, 0 to 100, built from your VO₂ max, your body composition, and your consistency in training, nutrition and sleep over the last 30 days. Every input is broken out, so you can see where your score comes from.

Gives you today's actions. The prioritized moves for your training, your nutrition and your sleep, chosen for today.

Training: a program built for longevity. Zone 2, VO₂ max and strength sessions in your own heart-rate zones, built around your equipment and your schedule. Every exercise demonstrated on video.

Nutrition: calories set by your body composition, protein set by your bodyweight, and a calorie balance that carries across days and grows with what you train. Log your meals and run a fasting timer: you pick the fasting protocol, Vantage keeps the clock and the history.

Sleep: up to six sleep tactics built from your nights and your habits (schedule, bedroom, caffeine, alcohol, late meals), ranked by how much each should lift your sleep score. After 30 nights, see which of your behaviors actually move it.

WHO IT'S FOR

People who take their health seriously, want the evidence-based version, and are tired of dashboards that measure everything and tell you nothing. If you already think in terms of healthspan, not just lifespan, Vantage was built for you.

WHAT VANTAGE WON'T DO

No streaks to break. No badges. No gamification. No dark patterns. No shame when you miss a day. No ads. No selling your data. A coach, not a slot machine.

SUBSCRIPTION

Free: your daily Recovery score, sleep metrics, nutrition logging and fasting timer
Premium: the Longevity score, today's actions, and your training, nutrition and sleep plans. Monthly or annual, each with a 7-day free trial. Sub

quotes.text:
Hello, there. This is Petre, Adrian and Diana and we are building Vantage while maintaining day jobs and poor relationships with sleep. We shipped Vantage to the App Store on August 12th and we currently have 24 installs and 9 subscribers - all warm leads - one of them is our accountant.

Vantage is an iOS longevity coach built on Apple Health. I have used numerous apps to track nutrition, sleep and workout guidance, my main complaint has always been that there isn’t one that encompasses all these streams, at a level of detail that is sufficient for me

So what does Vantage do? It reads your health data and returns one prioritized action per day for each stream: sleep, training and nutrition.

Workouts: Training plans are generated from your fitness levels (strength and cardio), either self reported (strength) or read from Apple Health (cardio - based on VO2Max). We have instructional videos filmed professionally with fitness instructors and filming crew

Nutrition: Calories and protein are computed, protein from bodyweight, carbs and fat split per user choice, based on preferred diet style.
Sleep: up to six ranked tactics running on 31 active rules, refreshed daily based on last night’s sleep data. HRV, resting heart rate and respiratory rate calculated on overnight data

So what does Vantage do differently?
No streaks, badges and points.

No social anything. No feeds, no leaderboards, no comparison.

No free coaching tier. Free shows you your HealthKit data exactly as we …
